en: In the last course section, we learned how
proper naming can help us with the code
readability and therefore with the
maintainability of code.
In this course section, we're going to dive
into things we can do beyond naming things
to improve readability or to hurt it, as you
will learn, because this section is about
comments and code formatting.
And it turns out that both can be used to
improve our code or to make it worse.
Therefore, we'll learn that comments are
mostly bad, but I will also explain which
kind of comments would be good.
We will learn that code formatting is
important and how to format our code, also
how to adhere to language conventions.
And of course, again, we'll have examples,
demos, and a challenge for you so that you
again are able to apply all these concepts
not just in theory but also in your own
projects.
